messages:
mira: quick heads-up: opened a tiny hotfix PR to add the public status permalink and a short customer workaround for last night's inference failover. Need one reviewer and a green docs-preview so we can merge before the 16:00 customer sync.
ben: drop the PR link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — edits: add status.redwood.com permalink to /operational/incidents, Known Issue blurb about KV-cache invalidation during autoscaler leader failover, short ops steps, and updated JS/Python SDK retry examples plus a migration note.
tia: I can do a prose pass. FYI the docs build has been strict about external permalinks; double-check the slug.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #789 — error: broken external link https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover (HTTP 404). See CI log.
sre_oliver: correct public permalink is https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-postmortem. Update that and include the detection query under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[2m])) by (model,region)
```
mira: updated the permalink, added promql and the Dedicated note about queued requests. pushed.
deploy-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-789--docs.redwood.com — please review the rendered Known Issue and SDK snippets.
ben: nit: Python sample uses `retry=3`. prefer explicit backoff + `max_retries` and `timeout_ms`. Suggest:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.generate(model="redwood-7b", prompt="...", timeout_ms=90000, max_retries=4, backoff_ms=200)
```
mira: updated snippet per ben and force-pushed.
tia: staging smoke once promoted? @deploy-bot please promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #789 — status: in-progress.
tia: quick smoke passed, no rendering or link-checker failures now. I approve.
merge-bot: All required approvals present for PR #789. Running final CI checks.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #789.
merge-bot: PR #789 merged into main by mira at 1785001960. changelog entry queued.
support-raj: can you add a one-line customer blurb under "Customer note" so support can copy it? Suggest: "We experienced a brief model failover; please retry after 2 minutes and check the incident page: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-postmortem"
mira: added the customer blurb and left TODOs for translations and internal backport. I'll open a follow-up to backport the ops-admin snippet to internal runbooks. Thanks team.
